item.title: Bulletin updated at 19:55 HKT 16/May/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a relatively dry continental airstream, the weather will improve over Guangdong in the next couple of days. A trough of low pressure is expected to affect southern China in the latter part of this week, the weather over the region will be unsettled with thundery showers.

Date/Month: 17/05 (Tuesday)
Wind: Northeast force 4, becoming east force 5 later.
Weather: Becoming fine. Dry during the day.
Temp range: 19 - 25 C
R.H. range: 60 - 80 per Cent
PSR: Low

Date/Month: 18/05 (Wednesday)
Wind: East force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore at first.
Weather: Sunny periods. Dry during the day.
Temp range: 22 - 26 C
R.H. range: 60 - 80 per Cent
PSR: Low

Date/Month: 19/05 (Thursday)
Wind: East force 3 to 4, occasionally force 5.
Weather: Sunny intervals. One or two showers later.
Temp range: 23 - 27 C
R.H. range: 70 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Low

Date/Month: 20/05 (Friday)
